body.objective: Close the bootstrap gap between `s-f work report` and `s-f work commit` for ordinary scientific deliveries that create new files. The documented workflow requires a WORK_REPORTED event before `work check` or `work commit` can obtain changed_paths, but the SF5 report containment gate refuses a resolvable current_commit that does not already contain every reported path. A normal physics result creates a new certificate, schema, verifier, tests, receipt and report, so those paths cannot be honestly reported before the commit that `s-f work commit` is supposed to create. Using an unresolvable placeholder commit bypasses the gate but defeats the provenance guarantee.
body.stop_condition: Provide one auditable two-phase transaction for new and modified files. A worker must be able to declare the intended changed paths and verification metadata without claiming that uncommitted paths are already contained in a commit; `s-f work check` must dry-run exactly that intent; `s-f work commit --push` must use the isolated index and prospective-tree verification gate, create the commit, append the exact SHA and verification receipt, and seal or supersede the intent with a checkpoint whose current_commit is that SHA. A crash between intent, commit, event append and push must be resumable without duplicating a commit or losing provenance. Add a deterministic nested-programme regression containing at least one new file, one modified file, concurrent unrelated staged/unstaged/untracked files, a failed prospective-tree verifier, a successful retry and a moved-HEAD compare-and-swap retry. The final report/close containment gate must reject any event whose sealed commit lacks the delivered blobs.
body.forbid: no unresolvable or fake current_commit placeholder; no weakening of final commit containment; no use of the shared Git index; no broad staging; no silent omission of new files; no report mutation or history rewrite; no producer-time worktree test substituted for prospective-tree verification; no global serialization of all resident streams
notes: Live reproduction, 2026-07-20: `s-f work show --item bridge-finite-harmonic-tier3-provenance-relock` reports no checkpoint, and `s-f work check --item bridge-finite-harmonic-tier3-provenance-relock --agent bridge-1` refuses because no WORK_REPORTED event exists. The advertised next step is `work report`, but `tools/science-forge/s-f:560-590` verifies every reported path against current_commit before authoring that event. Any newly created deliverable therefore makes the report fail with exit 8.

The landed SF5 isolated-index, nested-path, prospective-tree and containment machinery otherwise passes the physics dry-run: `s-f work check --item bridge-kernel-direction-incidence-normal-form --agent bridge-1` maps the nested programme correctly, yields zero outside-allowlist paths and leaves hundreds of unrelated live changes under not-in-report-but-dirty.

A suitable interface could be `work intent` followed by `work commit`, or `work commit --changed-paths ... --report-fields ...` as one transaction. The exact spelling is not prescribed; the invariant is that an uncommitted intention and a committed checkpoint are distinct append-only event types.
